data.decision: Stop board-clearing because no live Plane board or PM binding exists
data.reasoning: The npm package, OIDC release, GitHub releases, upstream comment, and Docker runtime are verified complete. The canonical PJangler adapter cannot list tickets because .project.json has neither a board_id nor an agents role_dir. Creating a live Plane board is an outward-facing provisioning action that requires operator confirmation, so no board state was invented.
